text:
incident-bot: ALERT: P95 latency breach detected on /v1/chat/stream (region: us-west-2). Current p95=1.45s (SLO=0.9s), p99=4.8s. Error rate nominal. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

Alex: ack. I'm on it. collecting traces and logs now.

Priya: paging in. seeing a spike in preproc time, tokenizer tail is high on several hosts. grabbing profiling.

Miguel: confirming streaming stalls from user telemetry — lots of long-lived streams with delayed first chunk after preproc. Possibly template expansion or JSON mode.

Sam: Any customer impact visible? Support dashboard shows increase in streaming timeouts for a small set of enterprise tenants (IDs redacted).

Alex: timeline: spike started ~2240011100, coincides with a config rollout to preproc-service (prompt-template v2 flag). Rolling back candidate?

Priya: found a hot codepath in prompt assembly: repeated tool-schema validation for every invocation when template has many tool snippets. Quick fix: bypass schema validation for hot path.

Miguel: raw flame: preproc::expand_template -> tokenizer::encode (CPU spike) -> waiting on io to remote schema store. high tail on encode when template length > 8k chars.

Sam: Interim mitigation options: 1) Rollback prompt-template v2 2) Disable JSON mode for affected route 3) Route traffic to Dedicated nodes with higher CPU. Thoughts?

Alex: I'm starting a canary rollback of the prompt-template v2 flag on region us-west-2 (50% -> 0% over 5m). Will monitor p95.

Priya: while rollback runs, we can apply a config to short-circuit schema fetch: set TOOL_SCHEMA_CACHE_TTL=3600 on preproc hosts (already tested locally).

Miguel: deploying TTL change to preproc-service canary now: 
```
kubectl set env deploy/preproc SERVICE_ENV=prod TOOL_SCHEMA_CACHE_TTL=3600 -n inference
```

Alex: rollback complete on canary. metrics: p95 down from 1.45s -> 0.75s in canary cluster. pushing region-wide rollback now.

incident-bot: NOTICE: rollout detected: prompt-template v2 flag -> mark rollback in progress.

Sam: Support: notify impacted customers with short blurb. "We're investigating higher-than-normal response times for streaming in us-west-2; mitigation in progress. We'll update in 30 mins."

Priya: cache TTL applied to 10% of preproc hosts, no errors. CPU for preproc hosts decreased ~18% in canary.

Miguel: with rollback + TTL, p99 trending down from 4.8s -> 1.6s across region. still above SLO for p99, but p95 back under 0.9s.

Alex: next steps: confirm no regressions in output quality after template rollback, keep schema TTL for 12h, collect post-mortem notes.

Sam: oncall handoff in 30m to Priya. I'll prepare escalation notes for customers and a short internal status email.

Priya: I'll stay on until p99 < 1s for 15m. Also instrument extra logging around tokenizer length distribution: add metric preproc.template_length.p99.

Miguel: added a temporary dashboard: preproc latency by template length bucket and JSON mode flag. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/preproc-latency (canary only).

Alex: also opened a quick follow-up task: avoid re-validating tool-schema for every request (cache key by schema hash). assign to eng-ml.

incident-bot: SUMMARY: Mitigations applied: rolled back prompt-template v2 (region-wide), applied TOOL_SCHEMA_CACHE_TTL=3600 to preproc-service canaries -> expanded; dashboard and extra metrics added; support notified. Impact: p95 recovered, p99 improving.

Sam: Handoff notes for Priya: watch for any reintroduction of v2 flag, validate canary expansion step, ensure TTL doesn't mask underlying correctness bug (we'll revert TTL after patch).

Priya: ack. I'll run a focused regression test suite against a sample of templates including long tool schemas and JSON mode payloads.

Miguel: quick log snippet from affected host (sanitized):
```
[2240011158] preproc: expand_template id=XX len=11234 tool_refs=12 fetch_schema_ms=240 encode_ms=520 total_preproc_ms=980
```

Sam: ETA for postmortem draft? Alex/Miguel/Priya: can we have a first-pass within 6 hours?

Alex: yes. I'll collect traces and timelines and draft impact section.

Priya: I'll write mitigation/next actions and link PRs.

Miguel: I'll add perf profiles and suggested code changes (cache-by-hash + avoid full tokenization until necessary).

incident-bot: REMINDER: Oncall rotation will change at 2240012600.

Priya: noted. I'll be on for handoff at 2240012600, Sam will brief.

Sam: If anything regresses before handoff, @Priya please escalate immediately.

Alex: closing live thread — monitoring in follow-up channel. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
